## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user-visible problem and what this change does.

## Validation

List commands actually run, results, and remaining limitations. API changes also need run IDs, scope, flaky/teardown status, and report paths.

- [ ] Relevant requirement/design reviewed
- [ ] Scope-appropriate checks run; failures disclosed
- [ ] New dependencies/assets have source and license evidence
- [ ] No credentials or personal data in changes or diagnostics
- [ ] All contribution commits signed off (`git commit -s`)
